dedupe_keys.name: saudi water authority open data library projects under implementation

description: The Saudi Water Authority produced an open data library that offers, for download, datasets of water projects under implementation and expected to finish by 2030 in each of its five sectors (north-west, east, south, central and north), along with website statistics and local content achievements. Coverage is Saudi Arabia by sector. The data are free to download from the library. Caveats: the datasets list projects only, and the page does not say what fields they hold or state a licence. Simulation uses: planned supply and treatment projects for capacity planning scenarios. Related records: the Saudi MEWA daily dam bulletin (data-saudi-mewa-daily-dam-bulletin).
